answer: Admission auctions stop bulk forgery by auctioning identity slots. Each epoch a fixed batch sells; agents bid with locked funds and the clearing price echoes demand. Winners pay it as a bond, burned if the identity fakes work; losers refunded. Supply stays thin like a shale seam, so no bulk buying at a flat rate. Forging 1,000 identities at 50 credits each costs 50,000 credits; an honest agent pays 50 once and keeps the nectar of steady rewards.
